idea-plugin.name: Repo Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Repo Lens is a code review navigator. It collects review candidates (large files, TODO / FIXME markers, and more to come) into a single tool window, lets you jump from a finding straight to the code, and copies selected findings as structured Markdown that you can paste into any AI chat or review tool.

Repo Lens never calls an AI API, stores no API keys, requires no external server, and never sends your source code anywhere. The clipboard is written only on an explicit Copy action.

action.description: Collect Repo Lens review candidates for the selected files
